heading: Today
text: Morning fog burning off, then a mix of sun and clouds, with more sun developing through the afternoon. Highs in the mid to upper 50s, nearing 60 in the warmer valleys.  Calm wind, speeds increasing to 10 mph in the Champlain Valley, with gusts up to 20 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Variable clouds. Lows mainly in the mid to upper 30s, nearing 40 in the Champlain and Saint Lawrence Valleys. Calm wind, speeds near 10 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Partly cloudy north of Route 2, mostly sunny south. Highs from the mid 50s to near 60. Wind becoming west at 5 to 10 mph.
